_comment: Routing DATA for the generate-terraform fragment: which template emits for which design content, the service->file map, the unmapped->warning list, and template-variable sources. KNOWLEDGE per docs/unit-taxonomy-spec.md (evolves independently of the routing algorithm). The output SHAPE of generation-warnings.json is schemas/generation-warnings.schema.json; the .tf bodies are templates/generate/terraform/*.tmpl.

conditional_emit.when: a Private Space exists (vpc_design has a restricted SG / a space was in the inventory)
any service aws_service in {RDS PostgreSQL, Aurora PostgreSQL}

_emit_note: security.tf is ALWAYS emitted (pick restricted XOR standard). Exactly one vpc.tf variant. Domain files only when their service type is present. BOTH security templates define the per-tier SGs (alb/fargate/database/cache/messaging) that compute/database/cache/messaging reference — emit a tier's SG only when that service type is present so domain references resolve. The RESTRICTED variant differs only in the ALB external ingress (declared dependency CIDRs, not 0.0.0.0/0).

unmapped_to_warning._comment: Services with NO terraform resource mapping: SKIP (no .tf), log to generation-warnings.json. EXCEPTION: a CloudWatch Logs service from a logging add-on (Papertrail/Rollbar/Sentry) is integrated into compute.tf's log config — do NOT warn for it.
no_warn: CloudWatch Logs (integrated into compute.tf log configuration)
unmapped_to_warning.reason_template: No Terraform resource mapping available for {aws_service}
unmapped_to_warning.recommendation: Configure this service manually in the AWS Console or add a custom Terraform module

template_var_sources.existing_subnet_ids_hcl_list: aws-design.vpc_design.subnet_ids as an HCL list literal
template_var_sources.maintenance_window: preferences.global.maintenance_window formatted as a Terraform ddd:hh24:mi-ddd:hh24:mi window (flexible -> a documented default like 'sun:03:00-sun:05:00')
template_var_sources.node_type/automatic_failover/transit_enc: per-service aws_config (cache); num_cache_clusters = 2 if multi_az else 1
template_var_sources.broker_instance_type/broker_count/storag: per-service aws_config (messaging); kafka_version default 3.5.1; retention_hours = preferences.data.kafka_retention_days * 24
template_var_sources.major_version: the major of engine_version (e.g. 15 -> postgres15 / redis7)
template_var_sources.private_subnet_refs / public_subnet_refs: new_vpc -> aws_subnet.private[*].id / aws_subnet.public[*].id; existing_vpc -> the existing-subnet data source ids
template_var_sources.port_mappings_block: the containerPort 8080 portMappings block ONLY for process_type == 'web', else empty
template_var_sources.load_balancer_block: the load_balancer{} + depends_on block ONLY when aws_config.load_balancer == true, else empty
